description:
This episode ranks five leaders who won power through fair democratic elections before destroying the systems that elevated them. From Hugo Chávez reshaping Venezuela's institutions to Ferdinand Marcos imposing martial law in the Philippines, each case shows how elected officials systematically consolidated authority, suppressed opposition, and transformed democracies into tyrannies.
